entry_state: EPS allocations can include hypothetical tax consequences without creating journals. Consolidation uses evidenced control, identified entity books and a separate adjustment book. Acquisition, intragroup profit and tax, monetary remeasurement and presentation translation have distinct calculations. The foreign-subsidiary case follows goodwill, parent and NCI reserves, cash and disposal, including full removal on loss of control. The next section has begun binding those calculations to exact books, currencies and control intervals.
exit_state: The group extension binds calculations to books, branches and evidence views, preserves retries and leaves legal books intact. Eliminating an intragroup loan does not erase its currency exposure; settlement facts determine profit versus OCI. Transaction identity and control intervals govern eliminations. Hyperinflation restatement precedes translation, with monetary exposure, turnover and first-application tax handled separately. The exchangeability section has just introduced currency direction, date and purpose.
findings: The group implementation discussion preserves legal-book ownership, immutable alternative branches, atomic publication and exact retries as genuine software contracts.
The ordinary-loan and net-investment alternatives have equal final cash and equity but different profit and OCI; the exposure is not removed with the internal balance.
The intercompany inventory example derives group profit 36 both from eliminations and the external history.
The restatement example separates nominal monetary balances from indexed nonmonetary values and shows the turnover and deferred-tax qualifications. No new confirmed defect.
